kind_why: Scene headings such as “SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER,” acted action, and character-labelled dialogue tell a dramatized story.
language_of_dialogue: Sinhala, with occasional English words and phrases

problems.what: Missing letters or vowel components in the possessive and phone word; Sinhala vowel signs are also placed before their consonants.

where.quote: අෙන් , Thank you! මම දැක්ෙකවත් නෑ

problems.what: Sinhala vowel signs are in the wrong character order: “අෙන්” and “දැක්ෙකවත්” should be “අනේ” and “දැක්කෙවත්”.
Vowel signs precede the consonants they belong to, corrupting “බැංකුවෙන්වත්” and “කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්”.
Letters are missing: the intended words are “මගේ ව්‍යාපාරය”.
